attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determines if corporation must file Georgia state tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus. Nexus types: Physical presence (office, employees, property) or Economic nexus post-Wayfair ($100,000 gross receipts threshold).

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in GA (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_physical_presence is true AND apportionment.state_code is "GA"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq apportionment.state_code GA streq and

condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true AND apportionment.state_code is "GA"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.state_code GA streq and

action_details.action_description: Filing required due to physical presence. Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500.
Filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions.
No Georgia nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No GA nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Georgia state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Common GA additions: Interest on U.S. government obligations, IRC Section 199A deduction addback, State income taxes deducted federally. Common GA subtractions: Interest on Georgia state and local bonds, Georgia NOL deduction.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments
condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence is true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate GA state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_description: Calculate Georgia state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income per GA Form 600 Schedule 1.
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No GA nexus - no state adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Georgia state corporate income tax. Applies 5.75% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. Process: 1) Federal taxable income apportioned to GA (table 7500), 2) Add GA-specific additions (table 51120), 3) Subtract GA-specific subtractions (table 51120), 4) Apply GA tax rate 5.75%, 5) Subtract GA state credits, 6) Calculate refund or amount owed.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax
condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence is true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate GA tax at 5.75% flat rate
action_details.action_description: Georgia state corporate income tax calculation: Apply 5.75% flat rate, subtract credits, calculate refund or amount owed.
No Georgia nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No GA nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_description: No Georgia taxable income - no tax liability. Georgia NOL rules may apply for future carryforward (not implemented).
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No GA taxable income - no tax liability. NOL rules may apply for future carryforward (not implemented)." job.audit_trail swap addto
